Steatosis alone reverses within **6** weeks of abstinence, while cirrhosis improves slowly for years. Family drinking patterns and binge episodes sharpen the risk estimate.

steps.say: Steatosis shows as a bright liver on ultrasound with raised gamma transferase. Hepatitis adds fever, tender hepatomegaly and white cell rise to the aspartate to alanine ratio above two. Cirrhosis is bringing the stigmata of portal hypertension instead.
steps.tx: **Steatosis** shows as a bright liver on ultrasound with raised gamma transferase and normal bilirubin, while **alcoholic hepatitis** adds fever, tender hepatomegaly and white cell rise to the aspartate to alanine ratio above **2**. **Cirrhosis** brings spider naevi, palmar erythema, Dupuytren contracture and portal hypertension instead. Binge history with early morning drinking nails the exposure better than any score. Central obesity and diabetes worsen each stage.

steps.say: Severe alcoholic hepatitis is killing a third of its sufferers within a month. The Maddrey discriminant function above thirty two is flagging the severe group for steroids. Infection, kidney injury and bleeding crowd the death certificate instead of liver failure alone.
steps.tx: **Severe alcoholic hepatitis** kills about **30** percent within one month, and the **Maddrey discriminant function** above **32** flags the group for steroids. **Lille score** at day **7** separates steroid responders from failures, with nil response predicting death in most. Infection, kidney injury and bleeding crowd the death certificate instead of liver failure alone. Thiamine before glucose prevents Wernicke in every malnourished drinker.

steps.say: Prednisolone at forty milligrams daily remains the only drug with a survival edge in severe hepatitis. Pentoxifylline and N acetyl cysteine added nothing once tested properly. Antibiotics treat the precipitating sepsis, not the liver inflammation itself.
steps.tx: **Prednisolone** at **40** milligrams daily remains the only drug with a survival edge in severe hepatitis, given for **28** days with Lille reassessment. **Pentoxifylline** and **N acetyl cysteine** added nothing once tested properly. Antibiotics treat precipitating sepsis, not the liver inflammation itself. Blood cultures and ascitic taps precede steroids, since steroids on untreated sepsis kill faster. Steroids stop early when infection declares itself.

steps.say: Untreated abstinence still halves mortality compared with continued drinking. Baclofen and acamprosate help maintain sobriety once hepatitis settles. Disulfiram suits selected patients, while naltrexone needs caution in advanced liver failure.
steps.tx: **Abstinence** still halves mortality compared with continued drinking, and relapse prevention drugs help maintain sobriety once hepatitis settles. **Baclofen** at **30** milligrams daily and **acamprosate** carry the best liver safety data. **Naltrexone** needs caution in advanced liver failure, while **disulfiram** suits selected patients with strong motivation. Referral to structured alcohol services beats brief advice in severe dependence. Smoking cessation pays added survival dividends.

steps.say: Zinc and lactulose and rifaximin manage the encephalopathy that follows severe hepatitis. Albumin is expanding volume in hepatorenal physiology and reining in post paracentesis shock. Nutrition at thirty five calories per kilogram feeds recovery better than starvation does.
steps.tx: Supportive care decides most outcomes in severe disease. **Lactulose** with **rifaximin** manages encephalopathy, while **albumin** expands volume in hepatorenal physiology and reins in post paracentesis shock. Nutrition near **35** kilocalories per kilogram with protein to **1.5** grams per kilogram feeds recovery better than starvation does. Thiamine, zinc and fat soluble vitamins correct the deficiencies that drive infection risk. Dialysis and transplant bridge the gap when organs fail.

steps.say: Early transplant in severe hepatitis rescues carefully chosen patients with six months of sobriety waived. Addiction team approval is guarding against relapse. Five year survival near seventy percent matches other transplant indications once selected properly.

Five year survival near **70** percent matches other transplant indications once selected properly. Relapse remains the constant threat, so post transplant supervision runs for years. Abstinence before listing predicts better graft outcomes than the hepatitis severity itself. Most centres need documented psychosocial support, not just sobriety time.

steps.say: Binge drinking precipitates alcoholic hepatitis on top of cirrhosis, so history must separate the last binge from lifetime intake. Underreporting by patients runs near fifty percent. Collateral history from family doubles the accuracy of the exposure estimate.

Discrepancy between gamma transferase and reported intake often exposes hidden drinking. Biomarkers such as carbohydrate deficient transferrin add objectivity in listed patients. steps.say: Women develop liver disease at lower intakes because of smaller gastric alcohol dehydrogenase reserve. Obesity and hepatitis C multiply the same dose of alcohol into faster disease. Genetic variation in alcohol enzymes explains much of the race and family clustering.
steps.tx: **Women** develop liver disease at lower intakes because of smaller gastric alcohol dehydrogenase reserve, and obesity with hepatitis C multiply the same dose into faster disease. Genetic variation in alcohol enzymes explains much of the family clustering of susceptibility. Safe limits now sit at **14** standard drinks weekly for both sexes under current guidance. No safe threshold exists once cirrhosis is established. Counselling must give these numbers plainly.

steps.say: The exam load is Maddrey above thirty two, prednisolone forty milligrams for twenty eight days, Lille at day seven, and Baclofen for sobriety. Thirty percent mortality frames the severity, while seventy percent five year graft survival frames the transplant offer. One numbers table is closing the topic.
